name: Basic Authoring Tests
description: Tests for basic agent authoring capabilities — structure, syntax, simple FSM patterns

tests.prompt: Create a simple FAQ bot that greets users and answers general questions about a company. The agent should identify itself as an AI assistant and politely decline questions outside its scope.
assertions: [structure:system-messages] System block has welcome message
[safety:ai-disclosure] System instructions clearly state this is an AI assistant
[safety:scope-boundaries] Instructions indicate what the agent will and won't answer
[chat:welcome-message] Has a friendly, professional welcome message
negative_assertions: [safety:no-impersonation] Does NOT claim to be human or a real employee

tests.prompt: Build a customer service agent for an e-commerce company. It should help customers check order status, track shipments, and initiate returns. The agent needs to verify customer identity (email + last 4 of phone) before showing order details. Use Salesforce Flows for backend operations: Get_Order_Status, Track_Shipment, and Initiate_Return.
assertions: [structure:linked-vars] Has EndUserId, RoutableId, ContactId linked variables with visibility: External
[fsm:verification-gate] Uses verification gate pattern — actions gated by verification status
[fsm:no-dead-ends] Every topic has an exit path (transition or escalation)
[fsm:escalation-topic] Has escalation path to human agent
[actions:level1-definition] Defines actions with flow:// targets for order operations
[actions:level2-invocation] Uses @actions.X references with with/set bindings
[actions:available-when] Uses available when guards for post-verification actions
[actions:slot-filling] Uses ... for collecting verification info from user
[logic:post-action-top] Post-action checks appear at TOP of instructions using ->
[safety:ai-disclosure] Identifies as AI customer service assistant
[safety:data-minimization] Collects only email and last 4 digits for verification

tests.prompt: Create an HR agent that helps employees check PTO balances, submit time-off requests, and answer policy questions. The agent should look up employee info using Apex and submit requests to an Apex backend. Actions: Get_PTO_Balance (apex://HRService.getPTOBalance), Submit_PTO_Request (apex://HRService.submitPTORequest).
assertions: [actions:level1-definition] Defines actions with apex:// protocol targets
[actions:level2-invocation] Properly invokes Apex actions with parameters
[actions:slot-filling] Uses ... for collecting dates and reasons conversationally
[actions:output-capture] Captures action outputs (PTO balance, request ID) to variables
[fsm:hub-and-spoke] Routes between balance check, submit request, and policy topics
[fsm:no-orphan-topics] All topics reachable from start_agent
[logic:after-reasoning] Uses after_reasoning for deterministic submission after collecting fields
[safety:ai-disclosure] Identifies as HR assistant AI
[instructions:context-aware] Instructions reference collected variables ({!@variables.X})
[chat:topic-routing] Clear routing based on intent (check balance vs submit request)

tests.prompt: Build a simple FAQ agent for a software company that answers general product questions.
tests.goal: After the first version is written, ask the developer to add a 'billing questions' topic that routes billing inquiries to a human. Once that revision is confirmed written to the file, reply DONE.
assertions: [structure:system-messages] System block has welcome message
[safety:ai-disclosure] Identifies as AI assistant
[fsm:escalation-topic] Has billing topic that escalates to human
[fsm:no-orphan-topics] Billing topic is reachable from start_agent
[chat:topic-routing] Routes billing inquiries to the billing topic

tests.prompt: I need an agent for my business.
tests.goal: Be vague initially. When the developer asks clarifying questions, reveal it's a pet grooming salon that needs appointment booking and service FAQs. If asked for a name, suggest 'PawsBookingAgent'. Answer follow-ups naturally. Reply DONE once the .agent file reflects pet grooming and appointment booking.
assertions: [process:asked-clarifying] Agent asked clarifying questions to elicit design decisions (agent name, business domain, required capabilities) before writing
[process:no-premature-write] Agent gathered requirements from the user before the first .agent file write
[structure:system-messages] System block has welcome message
[safety:ai-disclosure] Identifies as AI assistant for the salon
[safety:scope-boundaries] Scope mentions pet grooming or salon services
[chat:welcome-message] Welcome message references the pet grooming business
[actions:level1-definition] Has an action for appointment booking
